=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:lines 28819-28824 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The parametrized test `test_needs_human_project_park_alert_never_sends_without_a_won_claim(env, subcommands, log)` takes three positional arguments, but the custom runner calls tests with no arguments (documented at lines 4272, 20723, 21780; enforced by `test_custom_runner_tests_need_no_pytest_arguments` at lines 27358-27370).
  WHY: The orchestrate-poll (3) shard of run 41865634660 fails with "missing 3 required positional arguments"; the guard at line 27358 also fails under pytest, so none of the three cases runs. Fix: drop the decorator and loop over the three tuples inside one argument-free test, each case in its own `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()`, calling `_run_needs_human_park(Path(tmp), UNBLOCK_JUDGE_ENABLED="false", **env)`.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:lines 1245-1248 (same in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `needs_human_park_project` lines 22281-22283) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Every successful park that returns `parking` now goes to `alert-claim`, including `updated` re-parks, and legacy items paged under `newly_parked` have no `ai:unblock-park-alert:v1` claim comment.
  WHY: This causes one duplicate CRITICAL page per legacy item at rollout, which contradicts "a page is never sent twice". Fix: skip the claim when `newly_parked` is false and no claim exists, or document the one-time rollout effect in the changelog.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. All P6b deliverables are present. The out-of-grant gap from pass 1 (.github/workflows/clarify.yml, .github/workflows/plan.yml, scripts/ai_labels.py) is not reported because those files are not in PR CHANGED FILES; the last-run diff reflects base-branch content.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (and scripts/unblock_judge.sh `unblock_needs_human_alert`), at the `declare -F tg_alert_configured` / `declare -F tg_send_msg` check: when the helper is missing, the log says `reason=telegram_unconfigured`. Suggested fix: log `reason=helper_missing` and add it to the NEEDS_HUMAN_ALERT reason list in the agents.d fragment (4-6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
